author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1-v1.8 (v1.8 receipt c32d3582...ce96). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: whether a local, momentary behaviour (brief during a commute, during a difficult month) is a correct action is not decided by the organism: it simply asks the conductor / creator. That is the conductor in action.

layers.CHARACTER: v1.6 organism, unchanged (need_reader_v1_6.py). Proposes character change for the owner's signature.
layers.MAP: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged. Runs at the same needs, never changes character, never acts on its own: when it has a confirmed find it ASKS the conductor.

map.local_scout: at each need, for every region not already pending and not already asked about: frontier (days d-13..d) excess over that region's own history before the 42-day span; discovery if eligible (>=5 messages in both) and one-sided z > 3.4155 (p < 0.01 Bonferroni-corrected over 16 regions). Each discovery becomes a pending find (region, day f).
map.witness: a different member arrives at the first need >= 14 days after f and reads the SAME region on days f+1..d only, against that region's history before f-41. Confirmed iff z > 2.326 (single pre-specified region, no correction). Otherwise the find lapses: knowledge, no penalty.
map.ask: all regions confirmed at the same need form ONE ask to the conductor, provided the character layer has not already proposed. The housekeeper records asked regions; a region already asked about is never asked again (knowledge, not repetition).
map.conductor: the conductor's ANSWER is not simulated. This version measures only what the organism asks, where, when, and how often.

ground_truth_for_scoring_asks_only.real_patterns: GENUINE, COMMUTE, DINNER, WINDOW, COLOCATED carry a real change somewhere; NULL carries none.

predictions.AA1_character_untouched: character-layer propose_day identical to v1.6 on every one of the 5,400 streams.
predictions.AA2_no_alarm_on_noise: share of NULL owners with any ask <= 0.05 at lambda 32 and at lambda 128.
predictions.AA3_local_patterns_seen: share of COMMUTE owners asked >= 0.50 and of DINNER owners asked >= 0.50 at lambda 128.
predictions.AA4_asks_name_the_place: at lambda 128, >= 80% of regions asked about on COMMUTE owners are commute regions {2,3}, and >= 80% on DINNER owners are dinner regions {6,14}.
predictions.AA5_burden: mean ask events per owner <= 3 for every family at lambda 32 and at lambda 128.
predictions.AA6_real_change_seen: share of GENUINE owners asked >= 0.50 and of WINDOW owners asked >= 0.50 at lambda 128.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact numbers; lambda 32 and 8 reported descriptively where not predicted. No change after the first full run.
